evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies interfaces::Mining, src/node/block_template_manager, and mining.capnp.
rationale: Exposes template memory tracking via `getMemoryLoad()` to solve pinned non-mempool memory visibility for IPC mining clients. It directly supports external miner integration, addressing issue #33899 with an active consumer in Stratum v2 Template Provider (PR stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63).
